stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig presses the button for the TV
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Dialogue): What pops up when Daddy Pig presses the button?
Options:
A) A little TV 📺
B) A toaster 🍞
Guidance: Encourage the child to point and say: 'A TV!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig looks at the tricky map
stopPoints.question:
Question (Story & Dialogue): Are Peppa and her family lost?
Options:
A) Yes, they are lost! 🗺️
B) No, they are home 🏡
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Yes, lost!'

stopPoints.label: Grandad Dog explains the sat-nav
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Action): Who stops to help Peppa's family on the road?
Options:
A) Grandad Dog and Danny Dog 🐶
B) Miss Rabbit 🐰
Guidance: Encourage the child to call out: 'Grandad Dog!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Sheep finds the engine at the back
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Dialogue): Where did Mummy Sheep find the camper van's engine?
Options:
A) At the back of the van 🚐
B) Up in a tree 🌳
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'At the back!'

stopPoints.label: The camper van roof lifts up for bedtime
stopPoints.question:
Question (Visual & Action): What does the roof of the camper van do for bedtime?
Options:
A) It lifts up to make upstairs beds 🛏️
B) It flies away like an airplane ✈️
Guidance: Encourage the child to stretch their arms up and say: 'Lifts up upstairs!'
